title: Suspected cyanide worth P1.74M seized in Sarangani; 2 arrested

blocks.text: KORONADAL CITY — Police arrested two men and seized 1.45 tons of suspected sodium cyanide worth an estimated P1.74 million after intercepting a truck carrying the chemicals in Maasim, Sarangani province, before dawn Wednesday. The Maasim Maritime Law Enforcement Team (MLET), in coordination with the Maasim Municipal Police Station and Regional Maritime Unit 12 (RMU12), stopped a white Isuzu Forward truck with plate number KBF 1148 at around 12:30 a.m. in Sitio Tampuan, Barangay Kamanga. Police identified the suspects only by their aliases: “Kitoy,” 31, the driver, and “Totoy,” 59, his helper. Both are residents of Pantukan, Davao de Oro. READ: […]...
